reason: ABMLL amortizes Bayesian meta-learning into LoRA variables so LLMs can be adapted to multiple datasets for few-shot generalization (CrossFit/Unified-QA); it is a fine-tuning/meta-learning method for training-time adaptation, with no inference-system or serving contribution.
title: Meta-Learning at Scale for Large Language Models via Low-Rank Amortized Bayesian Meta-Learning
